title: Return of Protection Fee on a Keyturn Guest Protection Plan Election
content:
Protection fee under the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan is returned against one identified earlier line, so
every refund names the fee line it gives back and never exceeds what that line took.

A fee line already returned in full is not returned again, so where a refund already stands against the same fee
line and that refund was not itself reversed, the request is a duplicate and no further money moves.

Where the trip is cancelled before it starts the fee is returned at the level's cancellation refund percentage,
and where the trip is shortened the unused days are returned only on the levels that allow proration; a level
that does not prorate returns nothing for days not taken.

A guest who changes their mind inside the level's refund window after electing gets the fee back in full,
counted in whole elapsed hours from the moment the level was chosen, and after that window only the proration
rules apply.

Nothing is returned on an election that has already met a loss, because the cover was used.

Money is returned by the route it arrived on and reaches the guest with the trip refunds of the same booking
rather than separately.

## What makes a second request a duplicate

The fee line the refund names is what the marketplace reads, and it reads it before returning anything. Where a
refund already stands against that same fee line and has not itself been reversed, the request is a duplicate
and no further money moves. A return against a different fee line is not a duplicate, and two returns are told
apart by the day they were made, the amount and the reason recorded against them.

## The four grounds, side by side

| The ground | What comes back |
|---|---|
| The trip is cancelled before it starts | The level's cancellation refund percentage of the fee |
| The trip is shortened | The unused days, but only on a level that allows proration; a level that does not prorate returns nothing for days not taken |
| The guest changes their mind inside the level's refund window after electing | The fee in full |
| The election has already met a loss | Nothing, because the cover was used |

**Boundary reading of the refund window.** The window is counted in whole elapsed hours from the moment the
level was chosen. On a hypothetical level whose window is 24 hours, a change of mind at 24 whole elapsed hours
is inside the window and the fee comes back in full; at 25 whole elapsed hours the window has passed and only
the proration rules apply.
